_how_to: One row per vendor statement meeting the commitment definition. Copy each quote exactly from its source document. language = exploratory | conditional | firm. commitment_ids refer to C01-C07. A single statement may map to multiple commitments. Customer context belongs in commitments.json. Rows currently cover HB-01 to HB-03; continue from HB-04.

statements.speaker: Priya Raman (Elva)
statements.quote: We're exploring whether Elva's pre-built connector to a blockchain analytics provider can return real-time screening results for Polygon wallets in time for your launch.

statements.speaker: Priya Raman (Elva)
statements.quote: We're targeting a 1 December go-live, provided Harbour Bank's sandbox and testnet access is available by 15 November.

statements.speaker: Maya Chen (Elva)
statements.quote: If Product grants named approval, Elva's pre-built integration to the selected blockchain analytics provider could return real-time screening results for Polygon wallets as a limited beta; planned general availability in Singapore is 31 March 2027.

statements.speaker: Elva (RFP response)
statements.quote: Through its pre-built connector to a blockchain analytics provider, Elva will return real-time wallet-screening results for Ethereum and Polygon before every NUSD payout is released.
